content.comment_body: Hello, I'm having trouble with this [product_name] module, even though it should handle a basic task. The module is supposed to read analog and digital states, then send an SMS message. It should also reply with analog values based on a received SMS. I've attached a sample program and config file, along with a brief editable [document]. Currently, the module reads data from [product_name] via Modbus TCP protocol. The module is operational—SMS sends on power events. I'm clearly missing something. Please review my attachment and provide any effective help. Thank you in advance. Best regards, [user_name]
Have you enabled Modbus access in the file properties of [product_name]?
Why are you using Modbus instead of the S7 connection?
I tried this approach… If someone can show me how to use the S7 connection, I’ll follow that method. I just want to achieve the needed functionality.

I'd suggest submitting a Support Request. Edit: It's disappointing that [company_name] sells this device, yet the only documentation found on their site is poorly written. They should provide practical application examples.
Hi, The module only communicates with Modbus TCP with [product_name], if S7-communication is also set up in [product_name]. Refer to chapter A of the [document]. Hope this helps
Who came up with this? That sounds theoretical...

Dear [user_name], I turned to the forum in hopes someone with similar experience could quickly spot my mistake. I think the product is incomplete and could be improved, as it seems to be designed for a niche audience. It feels like [company_name] made it for one or two projects and then released it broadly, but the documentation is lacking. The only example provided isn't sufficient. There should be clear examples for reading inputs, outputs, and markers using both Modbus and S7 protocols. I haven't found such examples and see this as a gap in support. I'll contact product support, but I'm concerned that due to their size, useful help may be hard to get. That’s why I’m asking here, hoping for a quicker and more practical solution.
I've asked for support now—hopefully I'll get helpful information to share with everyone.

In chapter 5.4.6.3 describing Modbus connection setup, there's no mention of needing to activate S7 access. You first spend hours exchanging data over Modbus, then later read in chapter A.2 that S7 activation is required too. Is this really how [company_name] operates? If so, that's disappointing.
Hi, Did you ever find a solution for connecting S7 to [product_name] BM? I've tried various examples but haven't succeeded.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are encountering difficulties configuring the [product_name] Communication Interface Module to reliably read analog and digital states from [product_name] and transmit SMS messages. Key UX challenges include unclear documentation and a lack of practical integration examples for using both Modbus TCP and S7 protocols. This insufficient guidance leads to user frustration and uncertainty, suggesting the product lacks robust support for typical real-world tasks.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a simple setup for reading states from [product_name] and performing SMS communication with the module. They also want straightforward documentation and practical examples for common scenarios.
